description:
The Defense Loglstlcs Agency ( DLA) wlll issue a Request for Proposal on
March 10 2026 at https://www.dibbs.bsm.dla.mll /. The proposed
contract wlll be soliclited as Unrestricted With Other Than Full and Open
Competition. The NSNs listed on the
Request For Proposal (RFP) will have a
contract minimum and maximum set at the NSN level.
An Indefinite Quantity Contract with one base year and four (4) possible
option years is anticipated. The total duration, base period plus option
years, shall not exceed 5 years.
The solicitation is for 47 NSNs and will be solicited using FAR Part 12
Acquisition of Commercial Products procedures. Inspection point
of Destination will be noted in Section B as well as any other technical and
packaging requirements.
While price may be a significant factor in the evaluation of offers, the final
decision will be based on a combination of price, past performance,
delivery, and other factors listed in Sections L and M of the solictation.
The solicitation will be available for 30 days at
https://www.dibbs.bsm.dla.mil under Requests For Proposal SPE7LX-26-R-
0026 on March 10 2026.

This acquisition involves a consolidation of requirements IAW FAR 7.107-2 and has been determined necessary and justified. The determination will be posted with the solicitation IAW 7.107-5(c).

.
